## What choice is being made or allowed to become inevitable?

## Who is affected?

## What alternatives are currently underexplored?

## What evidence would help distinguish among them?

## Why does this decision need attention now?

## Existing work / prior art

Link relevant research, institutions, projects, laws, standards, datasets, or active efforts so the workshop can inherit rather than reinvent.

## Proposed first work packets

What bounded questions could contributors attack independently?

## Risks of opening this workshop

Could public work on this problem create safety, privacy, capability, security, legal, or other risks? What boundaries would be needed?
